source_classes.distinct_unit: Edition / canonical payload / individual record; none imply the whole research estate
minimum_source_witnesses: record ID, JSON pointer and record hash
original source references and their own rights
prospective_operations_for_separate_revi: native search/get/cite/integrity on an authorized isolated record set
source_classes.independent_comparator_class: B3 original reference-library comparison with the approved exact subset; browser/product parity separate

source_classes.distinct_unit: Zenodo Work / publication / original file / version are distinct
minimum_source_witnesses: original-byte hash and independently retained capture witness
licence and exact native epoch/seal scope
source_classes.independent_comparator_class: Exact original runner only with its complete read set independently authorized; synthetic Python parity does not prove corpus parity

source_classes.distinct_unit: Capture / original blob / text derivative are distinct
minimum_source_witnesses: exact parent linkage and derivative/observation clocks
prospective_operations_for_separate_revi: read-only exact derivative operation explicitly permitted later
source_classes.independent_comparator_class: Pinned original native function on the approved source-matched input contract; no gate #758 sync inferred

source_classes.distinct_unit: Public metadata row / post identity / typed declared relation; bodies excluded
minimum_source_witnesses: exact public snapshot and source ID
prospective_operations_for_separate_revi: metadata lexical query or declared typed topology only
source_classes.independent_comparator_class: Original public compiler/query on the same approved metadata, never an unrelated substitute snapshot

source_classes.distinct_unit: Private post body / group membership / metadata are distinct
adverse_controls: public metadata treated as private access
source_classes.independent_comparator_class: HELD: private restoration has no current authorized comparator or access route

source_classes.distinct_unit: Original file / capture / manifestation / Work are distinct
minimum_source_witnesses: specifically named original source ID and file/member
prospective_operations_for_separate_revi: only a later individually authorized operation
adverse_controls: single member permission expanded to archive
source_classes.independent_comparator_class: HELD_EM_NATIVE_CORPUS_PARITY; original adapter full read closure must fit a separate grant before invocation

source_classes.distinct_unit: Derivative / parent original / manifestation are distinct
minimum_source_witnesses: original and derivative IDs and both hashes
same content privacy boundary as parent unless separately reviewed
prospective_operations_for_separate_revi: a bounded explicitly approved source-span operation later
source_classes.independent_comparator_class: Original native comparison only if all required registers/derivatives are independently allowed; portable comparison remains separately labeled

source_classes.distinct_unit: Operational Work grouping / manifestation / independent Work contribution are distinct
minimum_source_witnesses: each linked file has separate rights/custody
prospective_operations_for_separate_revi: retain ambiguity and run an approved bounded identity-sensitivity check later
source_classes.independent_comparator_class: Human-gated original identity witness plus source-matched native/recipient operation; historical 32–40 interval stays held

source_classes.distinct_unit: Exogenous observation / episode / source / claim / publication are distinct
minimum_source_witnesses: independently acquired evidence not determined by admitted bytes alone
adverse_controls: citation or deterministic transformation treated as independent measurement
source_classes.independent_comparator_class: Independent acquisition and claim-specific falsification; no such witness selected or produced here

common_required_tuple: fresh explicit Tawanna C. Miller approval for the exact future action
exact source ID, file/member, permitted byte range and original SHA-256
derivative identity and SHA-256 or explicit documented non-applicability
rights/licence/consent witness distinct from public accessibility
all transitive file/import/read effects within an independently reviewed allowlist
destination product version/namespace and separate entry identity
permitted operations and prohibited cross-source joins
independent source-matched comparator and predeclared adverse controls
external caller-held custody and restart/readback witnesses
prospective success/hold conditions and human closure

decision_rules.when: Any required item missing, unverified, contradictory, stale, withdrawn or out of scope
A future review form is complete
Any document flag, source count, hash, citation, seal-shaped string, prior CI or Library presence is offered as execution authority
Proposed real source or protected operation is requested under this B7 document
A native comparator requires any unauthorized linked register/source

negative_state_meanings.HELD: missing authority, evidence or lawful operation; not a negative scientific result
negative_state_meanings.EXECUTED_ZERO: a permitted operation ran and returned a scoped zero
negative_state_meanings.ABSENT: an available authorized lookup found no exact target within its stated scope
negative_state_meanings.UNAVAILABLE: required implementation/interface cannot be called; never relabel as executed zero

non_inference_rules: source staging does not admit source
profile schema validity does not prove implementations or custody
equal epoch/seal strings do not verify a seal
original creation provenance text does not attest an external human action
no synthetic record can be retrospectively relabeled as original source evidence
a one-file approval never authorizes a whole archive or linked read closure
same bytes do not independently establish common origin
an exogenous witness cannot be created solely by deterministic transformation of admitted data
no automatic product identity, graph/Work merge, privacy guarantee or scientific promotion
